#!/bin/sh
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT
while :; do sleep 30; done
---
Enforcing

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== create system user =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc
getent passwd inventorysvc

echo "== write unit file =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=OS Comparison Worker (inventory-worker)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
Restart=on-failure
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "== reload + enable + start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

echo "== status =="
sleep 2
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l || true

echo "== verify user + process =="
sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID -p User
MAINPID=$(sudo -n systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
ps -o pid,user,cmd -p "$MAINPID"

echo "== journal tail =="
sudo -n journalctl -u inventory-worker.service --no-pager -n 20
